blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Long video understanding increasingly relies on external memory to organize massive visual streams into compact representations.
However, most memory-based methods dynamically adapt how information is retrieved for different questions, while largely fixing what is remembered.
This mismatch makes missing details costly to recover, whereas stored information is valuable only when it can be reliably retrieved.
To address this issue, we propose VideoEvolve, a novel self-evolving framework that jointly evolves memory and retrieval for long video understanding.
Specifically, starting from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, VideoEvolve couples a Memory Evolver for selective memory augmentation with a Retrieval Evolver for adaptive retrieval over the evolving memory.
We then co-evolve the two Evolvers through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL), updating one while freezing the other.
To steer this alternating evolution, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) identifies whether the current bottleneck lies in memory or retrieval and directs optimization toward the more limiting side.
Furthermore, VideoEvolve introduces Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) to alleviate downstream feedback from over-specializing memory to a fixed set of training questions, shifting training toward underdeveloped yet learnable video capabilities.
By integrating Agentic RL with BEF and CEF, VideoEvolve transforms downstream reasoning experience into transferable capability updates, providing a concrete path from static long-video systems toward experience-driven, self-improving multimodal intelligence.
Extensive experiments on multiple long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoEvolve.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Long video understanding remains challenging for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), as task-relevant evidence is often sparsely distributed within videos that can last over an hour, while exhaustive visual processing incurs substantial computational costs ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) .
To address this challenge, recent agentic Video-MLLMs adopt two representative paradigms for selective information access: Video-Revisiting Methods , which localize and revisit question-relevant video segments to recover fine-grained visual evidence ( Ding et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) ; and Memory-Based Methods , which organize video content into persistent memory and adaptively retrieve relevant evidence from this compact representation ( Song et al., 2024 ; Yeo et al., 2026 ) .
By reusing stored information across questions, memory-based methods offer a scalable approach to long video understanding, with the quality of memory construction shaping the evidence available for subsequent retrieval and reasoning.
blocks.zh:
对多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)而言,长期视频理解仍然具有挑战性,因为与任务相关的证据往往很少在能够持续一个多小时的视频中分发,而详尽的视觉处理则需要大量的计算费用(Wu等,2024;Fu等,2025;Wang等,2025c)。
为了应对这一挑战,最近的代理视频-MLLM为选择性信息访问采用了两个有代表性的范式: 视频重温方法,将与问题相关的视频部分本地化并重温,以找回细微的视觉证据(Ding等,2026;Yang等,2026a;以记忆为基础的方法,将视频内容组织入持久性记忆,并适应性地从这种紧凑的表述中取回相关证据(Song等,2024;Yeo等,2026)。
通过跨问题再用所储存的信息,基于内存的方法为长相视频理解提供了可扩展的方法,内存构造的质量塑造了可供后续检索和推理的证据.

blocks.en:
Despite these advantages, existing memory-based methods largely follow a one-way adaptation paradigm (Figure 1 (a)), with two related limitations. (1) Limited Memory Adaptability : predefined construction policies rarely learn from downstream reasoning feedback ( Yeo et al., 2026 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) , so omitted evidence can repeatedly force costly raw-video revisits. (2) Memory–Retrieval Misalignment : construction and retrieval are typically optimized separately ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , without explicitly aligning what memory preserves with what retrieval can effectively access.
This raises our central question: can memory construction and retrieval learn to improve each other, enabling co-evolution of what to remember and how to retrieve?
blocks.zh:
尽管有这些优势,但现有的基于内存的方法主要遵循单向适应范式(图1(a)),有两个相关的局限性. (1)有限记忆可适应性 :预定义的建筑政策很少从下游推理反馈中吸取教训(Yeo等,2026;Choi等,2026),因此省略了证据,可以再三强迫昂贵的原始视频重访. (2)内存 - 检索误差:构造和检索一般是分开优化的(杨等,2025;林等,2026),没有明确地将保存的内存与检索能够有效访问的内容相配合.
这提出了我们的中心问题: 内存的构建和取回能否互相学习改善, 能够共同进化什么可以记住,怎样取回?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we propose VideoEvolve (Figure 1 (b)), a self-evolving framework that co-evolves memory construction and retrieval policies through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL) .
Starting from a reusable memory built from low-frame-rate video observations, the Memory Evolver learns to selectively augment stored evidence, while the Retrieval Evolver learns to search the evolving memory and revisit the raw video when needed.
With the Retrieval Evolver frozen, downstream reasoning feedback guides the Memory Evolver to improve memory construction; the Retrieval Evolver is then optimized over the updated, fixed memory.
This alternating process aligns what the system remembers with how it retrieves.
To guide subsequent cycles, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) compares memory-only and revisit-enabled reasoning, accounting for actual video revisits, to estimate the relative training needs of the two Evolvers and direct optimization toward the more limiting side.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们提出VideoEvolve(图1(b)),这是一个自演框架,通过交替的代理强化学习(Agentic RL)共同演变出内存构建和取回政策.
从一个从低帧率视频观测所构建的可再利用的内存开始,"记忆活化"学会有选择地扩充所储存的证据,而"检索活化"学会了搜索正在演化的内存并在需要时重温生视频.
随着检索Evolver被冻结,下游推理反馈指导了记忆Evolver改进内存构建;再将检索Evolver优化于更新后固定的内存.
此交替进程将系统记忆与检索方式相匹配 。
为了指导后续的周期,Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Reference(BEF)比较了仅存和再审的推理,计入了实际的视频再审,以估计两个Evolvers的相对训练需要并直接向更受限制的一面进行优化.

blocks.en:
While BEF allocates training effort according to the current memory–retrieval bottleneck, this allocation alone does not ensure the broad capability development required for generalizable long video understanding ( Fu et al., 2026 ) .
Repeated optimization on a fixed set of training questions may instead encourage question-specific specialization, motivating capability-level guidance for the co-evolution process.
To address this issue, we introduce Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) , which translates capability-level feedback into an adaptive training curriculum.
Specifically, CEF reweights training toward underdeveloped yet learnable capabilities while preserving broad coverage, and adjusts the sampling distribution as the two Evolvers improve.
By integrating bottleneck-aware resource allocation with capability-aware curriculum adaptation, VideoEvolve supports targeted and transferable co-evolution of memory and retrieval.
blocks.zh:
虽然BEF根据目前的内存-检索瓶颈来分配培训工作,但单靠这一分配并不能确保一般的长视频理解所需的广泛能力发展(Fu等人,2026年)。
一再优化一套固定的培训问题,则可能鼓励特定问题的专门化,激励能力层面对共同演变进程的指导。
为了解决这一问题,我们引入了能力-智能进化反馈(CEF),将能力层面的反馈转化为适应性培训课程.
具体地说,CEF在保留广泛覆盖面的同时,对不发达但可学习的能力进行再加权培训,并随着两种变迁的改善而调整抽样分布。
通过将瓶颈-意识资源分配与能力-意识课程调整相结合,VideoEvolve支持有针对性和可转让的内存和检索共同演变。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows:
(1) We propose VideoEvolve, a self-evolving framework that co-evolves memory construction and retrieval through alternating Agentic RL, enabling both policies to improve from downstream reasoning feedback.
(2) We introduce Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) and Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF), which respectively adapt training allocation to memory–retrieval bottlenecks and adjust the training curriculum toward underdeveloped yet learnable capabilities.
(3) Experiments on Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) ,
LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025c ) ,

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Long Video Understanding with MLLMs. Recent MLLMs have extended video understanding toward longer temporal contexts through time-aware modeling, long-context scaling, and adaptive visual compression ( Ren et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . Beyond directly processing more visual tokens, another line of work shifts toward selective and agentic video access. VideoAgent ( Wang et al., 2024 ) iteratively retrieves task-relevant visual information, DVD ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) performs autonomous search over multi-granular video databases, and LVAgent ( Chen et al., 2025a ) introduces multi-round collaboration among MLLM agents. More recent approaches further combine active video inspection with reinforcement learning: VideoZoomer ( Ding et al., 2026 ) learns coarse-to-fine temporal focusing, while VITAL ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , LongVT ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , and Ego-R1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) train agents to dynamically invoke visual or retrieval tools for long-horizon reasoning.
In summary, these methods primarily improve where and when to inspect the source video, while our work focuses on the complementary question of what should be persistently remembered for subsequent retrieval.
blocks.zh:
与 MLLMs 的长视频理解 。 近期的MLLMs通过有时间意识的模型制作、长文字缩放和适应性视觉压缩,将视频理解扩展至较长的时间背景(Ren等,2024;Shen等,2024;Chen等,2025b)。 除了直接处理更多视觉符号外,另一行工作转向选择性和代理性视频访问。 VideoAgent (Wang等,2024年) 迭接地检索与任务相关的视觉信息,DVD (Zhang等,2026c.) 进行对多角度视频数据库的自主搜索,而LVAgent (Chen等,2025a.) 引入了MLLM代理之间的多轮协作. 最近的办法进一步将积极的录像检查同强化学习结合起来: VideoZoomer (Ding等, 2026) 学习粗放到精准的时间聚焦,而VITAL (Zhang等, 2026b.), Long VT (Yang等, 2026a.), Ego-R1 (Tian等, 2026.) 列车代理动态地引用视觉或检索工具进行长视距推理.
简言之,这些方法主要改进了检查源视频的地点和时间,而我们的工作则侧重于一个补充性的问题,即哪些内容应当被持续地记住,供以后检索。

blocks.en: Memory-Based Long Video Understanding. Memory-based approaches retain video evidence for reuse across questions or as question-specific working memory. MovieChat and MA-LMM introduce sparse and online memory mechanisms ( Song et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . EgoRAG organizes captions into hierarchical textual memory ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , while HippoMM consolidates audiovisual events and combines summary retrieval with detailed recall ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . WorldMM ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) and MERIT ( Choi et al., 2026 ) construct and retrieve explicit memories using pretrained models without method-specific parameter updates. Training-based approaches include M3-Agent’s separately trained memorization and control models ( Long et al., 2026 ) , MemVid’s memory-grounded clue generation optimized through SFT and DPO ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , and Ego-R1’s learned tool controller over hierarchical memory ( Tian et al., 2026 ) . VideoEvolve focuses on alternating the optimization of memory construction and retrieval policies, while keeping the constructed memory reusable across questions.
blocks.zh: 基于记忆的长视频理解. 基于记忆的方法保留视频证据,供跨问题重复使用或作为特定问题的工作记忆. 电影 Chat和MA-LMM引入了稀有和在线的内存机制(Song等,2024;He等,2024.). EgoRAG将标题组织成分级的文字内存(Yang等,2025年),而HippoMM整合了视听事件,并结合了摘要检索和详细的召回(Lin等,2026年). WorldMM(Yeo等,2026年)和MERIT(Choi等,2026年)使用未经特定方法参数更新的预先训练模型构建并取回了明确的记忆. 基于培训的方法包括M3-Agent经过单独培训的记忆和控制模型(Long等,2026年),MemVid通过SFT和DPO优化了基于记忆的线索生成(Yuan等,2025年),以及Ego-R1对分级记忆的学习工具控制器(Tian等,2026年). 视频 Evolution侧重于对内存构建和取回政策的优化进行交替,同时将所构建的内存保留在各种问题中可重复使用.

blocks.en:
Agentic Reinforcement Learning and Self-Evolving Agents. Reinforcement learning has become an effective mechanism for improving multimodal reasoning and decision-making, spanning visual perception ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , general multimodal reasoning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and video reasoning ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Agentic RL further couples policy optimization with multi-turn interaction and tool use, enabling models to learn adaptive behaviors in external environments ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Tian et al., 2026 ) . Beyond single-policy optimization, recent self-evolving agents seek continual improvement from accumulated interaction experience: EvolveR ( Wu et al., 2025 ) distills reusable strategies from past trajectories, SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) recursively evolves a hierarchical skill library together with the agent policy, Agent0 ( Xia et al., 2025 ) constructs progressively challenging curricula through autonomous interaction, and Evolving-RL ( Fan et al., 2026 ) jointly optimizes experience extraction and utilization.
Existing self-evolving agents mainly improve reasoning strategies, skills, and experience use. For long-video agents, however, what to remember and how to retrieve form an equally fundamental axis of evolution: what is preserved determines what can be retrieved, while retrieval utility in turn determines what is worth preserving.
blocks.zh:
代理强化学习与自演代理. 加强学习已经成为完善多模式推理和决策的有效机制,跨越视觉认知(刘等,2025年),普通多模式推理(王等,2026年),视频推理(冯等,2026年). 代理RL通过多回合互动和工具使用进一步优化夫妇政策,使模型能够学习外部环境中的适应行为(Wang等,2025e; 丁等,2026;张等,2026b;杨等,2026a;田等,2026. 除了单一政策优化外,最近的自我演化剂寻求从累积的互动经验中不断得到改进:EvolveR(Wu等,2025年)从过去的轨迹中提炼出可再利用的战略;SkillRL(Xia等,2026年)与代理政策一起再生地演化出一个分级技能库;Agent0(Xia等,2025年)通过自主互动构建逐渐具有挑战性的课程;Evolving-RL(Fan等,2026年)共同优化了经验提取和利用.
现有的自发性代理人主要改善推理策略,技能和经验的运用. 然而,对于长视频代理人来说,要记住什么以及如何取回,构成了一个同样根本性的演化轴:保存什么决定可以取回什么,而取回的效用反过来决定值得保存什么.

blocks.en: 3.2 Memory Evolver: Learning What to Remember
blocks.zh: 3.2 记忆演进器:学习什么可以记住

blocks.en: The Memory Evolver (Figure 2 (a)) learns what information should be preserved through an Observe–Decide–Augment process. We first construct a fixed hierarchical Base Memory B B from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, organized into Root–Super–Macro nodes to provide broad temporal coverage and multi-granular retrieval anchors. The Base Memory remains fixed throughout evolution, while its complementary information acquisition is learned. Memory construction is question-agnostic, such that the Memory Evolver does not observe downstream questions or answers. The hierarchy, record schema, and retrieval organization are detailed in Appendix A.1.1 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present VideoEvolve, a self-evolving framework that closes the
learning loop between memory construction and retrieval for long video understanding.
Through alternating Agentic RL, reasoning feedback guides what memory preserves,
while the updated memory shapes how retrieval learns to access evidence.
BEF and CEF steer this loop toward current bottlenecks and underdeveloped yet
learnable capabilities. Across five benchmarks, VideoEvolve outperforms the
evaluated open-source Video-MLLM baselines, and its trained and training-free
variants lead their respective memory-based comparisons. Ablations and cycle-wise
analysis further support this feedback-guided co-evolution. More broadly,
VideoEvolve reframes memory from a fixed record of video content into a learnable
interface between perception and reasoning, with its construction and use refined
together through task experience.

blocks.en: A.1 Memory Construction and Versioning
blocks.zh: A.1 内存构建和版本

blocks.en: A.1.1 Fixed Hierarchical Base Memory
blocks.zh: A.1.1 固定等级 基础内存

blocks.en: We uniformly sample the video at 0.5 fps and divide it into Macro intervals of at most 30 seconds, with the final interval clipped to the video duration. The frozen Writer processes the sampled visual evidence and available subtitles to produce local events, entities, OCR records, and summaries. A Base extraction request accepts at most 24 frames, resized to a maximum long edge of 896 pixels. Six-second CaptionUnits provide temporal anchors for subtitles and saved keyframes; they do not imply an additional visual-captioning call every six seconds. Macro-level extraction is consolidated before higher-level Super summaries are constructed, and the Root provides navigation over the hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 我们以0.5英尺的高度对视频进行统一取样,并把它分为最多30秒的宏观间隔,最后间隔被剪接到视频持续时间. 被冻结的Writer处理抽样的视觉证据和可用的字幕,以制作本地事件,实体,OCR记录和摘要. 一个碱取请求最多接受24帧,被调整为最大长边896像素. 六秒Caption Units为字幕提供时标并保存了键框;它们并不意味着每六秒增加一次可视Caption呼叫. 宏层取出在构建更高层次的"超级摘要"之前被整合,而"根"则提供对分级的导航.

blocks.en: The Base is constructed once per video and is not rewritten during co-evolution. A policy version produces its own Delta from this same Base, and the published memory is the union of the Base and that version’s accepted records. Historical Deltas are not recursively accumulated. All questions associated with a video share this memory, while question text, answer options, ground-truth answers, and capability labels are excluded from the construction policy’s input. Entity records support local retrieval but do not constitute a guarantee of consistent identity tracking across the entire video.
blocks.zh: 该基地每段视频建造一次,在共同演化期间不重写. 一个政策版本从同一个基地产生自己的三角洲,出版的内存是基地的联盟和该版本的被接受的记录. 历史上的三角洲不是递相积累的. 所有与视频相关的问题都分享了这个内存,而问题文本、答案选项、地面真实答案和能力标签则被排除在建筑政策的投入之外。 实体记录支持当地检索,但不能保证在整个视频中持续追踪身份。

blocks.en: The Base separates a coarse-to-fine navigation hierarchy from its local evidence records and temporal index. Its three navigation levels are Root → \rightarrow Super → \rightarrow Macro : one video-wide Root, a set of higher-level Super groups, and the Macro intervals that cover the video. Their roles and stored content are as follows. 1. Root: video-level overview. The Root stores the full-video time range, duration, counts of Super and Macro nodes, a short description, and frequently mentioned entity names. Its description is formed deterministically by concatenating Super descriptions and retaining the first 500 characters; up to 20 entity names are selected by their frequency in Macro-level name lists. It provides an entry point into the video, not an exhaustive summary, and requires no additional Writer call. 2. Super: higher-level grouping. Each Super stores a label, a narrative description, key entity names, member Macro IDs, and aggregated temporal anchors. After Macro extraction, the frozen Writer is prompted to group temporally adjacent and semantically related Macros. Invalid or repeated Macro assignments are removed, and omitted Macros are assigned through deterministic fallback grouping. A Super spans the earliest start and latest end of its members; unlike a Macro, it has no fixed duration. 3. Macro: local evidence container. For a video of duration T T , Macro i i covers [ 30 ​ i , min ⁡ ( 30 ​ ( i + 1 ) , T ) ] [30i,\min(30(i+1),T)] seconds, for i = 0 , … , ⌈ T / 30 ⌉ − 1 i=0,\ldots,\lceil T/30\rceil-1 . Each Macro stores its ID, interval, label, summary, detailed narrative, entity descriptors, event and OCR summaries, state changes, and references to CaptionUnits and saved keyframes. The detailed local records are retained separately and remain accessible through their Macro membership. Thus, upper-level summaries do not replace the underlying records.
blocks.zh: 该基地将粗细至细的导航等级与其当地的证据记录和时间索引相分离. 它的三个导航级别是Root →\正右翼 Super →\正右翼 Macro :一个视频宽度Root,一组更高级的Super组,以及覆盖视频的Macro间隔. 他们的角色和所储存的内容如下. 1. 根:视频层面概览。 Root存储了全视频的时间范围,持续时间,超级和宏节点的计数,一个简短的描述,并经常被提及的实体名称. 其描述通过调取"超级"描述并保留前500个字符而形成决定性;在"宏级"名称列表中根据其频率选择了多达20个实体名称. 它提供了一个进入视频的切入点,而不是一个详尽无遗的总结,不需要额外的Writer呼叫. 2. Super:更高级别的分组. 每个 Super存储一个标签,一个叙事描述,关键实体名,成员Macro ID,以及汇总时间主播. 在Macro取出后,被被冰冻的作家被促使将时间相邻和相近的Macros分组. 无效或重复的Macro任务被去除,省略的Macros通过决定性倒置分组来分配. 一个"超级"横跨其成员最早的起始和最晚的结尾;与"宏"不同,它没有固定的长度. 3. 宏:当地证据容器。 T T, Macro i 的视频覆盖[30 i,min ⁡ (30 (i + 1), T )] [30 i,\ min (30 (i+1), T)] 秒,为i = 0,.,\ T / 30 → 1 i = 0,\ ldots,\ lceil T/30\rceil-1. 每个宏存储其ID,间隔,标签,摘要,详细叙述,实体描述符,事件和OCR摘要,状态变化,以及引用Caption Units和已保存的键框. 详细的当地记录是单独保存的,并通过其宏观成员身份保留。 因此,高层摘要不能取代基本记录。

blocks.en: Root: video-level overview. The Root stores the full-video time range, duration, counts of Super and Macro nodes, a short description, and frequently mentioned entity names. Its description is formed deterministically by concatenating Super descriptions and retaining the first 500 characters; up to 20 entity names are selected by their frequency in Macro-level name lists. It provides an entry point into the video, not an exhaustive summary, and requires no additional Writer call.
blocks.zh: root:视频级综述. Root存储了全视频的时间范围,持续时间,超级和宏节点的计数,一个简短的描述,并经常被提及的实体名称. 其描述通过调取"超级"描述并保留前500个字符而形成决定性;在"宏级"名称列表中根据其频率选择了多达20个实体名称. 它提供了一个进入视频的切入点,而不是一个详尽无遗的总结,不需要额外的Writer呼叫.

blocks.en: Super: higher-level grouping. Each Super stores a label, a narrative description, key entity names, member Macro IDs, and aggregated temporal anchors. After Macro extraction, the frozen Writer is prompted to group temporally adjacent and semantically related Macros. Invalid or repeated Macro assignments are removed, and omitted Macros are assigned through deterministic fallback grouping. A Super spans the earliest start and latest end of its members; unlike a Macro, it has no fixed duration.
blocks.zh: Super:更高级别的分组. 每个 Super存储一个标签,一个叙事描述,关键实体名,成员Macro ID,以及汇总时间主锚. 在Macro取出后,被被冰冻的作家被促使将时间相邻和相近的Macros分组. 无效或重复的Macro任务被去除,省略的Macros通过决定性倒置分组来分配. 一个"超级"横跨其成员最早的起始和最晚的结尾;与"宏"不同,它没有固定的长度.

blocks.en: Macro: local evidence container. For a video of duration T T , Macro i i covers [ 30 ​ i , min ⁡ ( 30 ​ ( i + 1 ) , T ) ] [30i,\min(30(i+1),T)] seconds, for i = 0 , … , ⌈ T / 30 ⌉ − 1 i=0,\ldots,\lceil T/30\rceil-1 . Each Macro stores its ID, interval, label, summary, detailed narrative, entity descriptors, event and OCR summaries, state changes, and references to CaptionUnits and saved keyframes. The detailed local records are retained separately and remain accessible through their Macro membership. Thus, upper-level summaries do not replace the underlying records.
blocks.zh: 宏:本地证据容器. T T, Macro i 的视频覆盖[30 i,min ⁡ (30 (i + 1), T )] [30 i,\ min (30 (i+1), T)] 秒,为i = 0,.,\ T / 30 → 1 i = 0,\ ldots,\ lceil T/30\rceil-1. 每个宏存储其ID,间隔,标签,摘要,详细叙述,实体描述符,事件和OCR摘要,状态变化,以及引用Caption Units和已保存的键框. 详细的当地记录是单独保存的,并通过其宏观成员身份保留。 因此,高层摘要不能取代基本记录。

blocks.en: Within a Macro, Event , Entity , and OCRText are typed evidence records, not additional navigation levels. An Event stores its ID, description, event type, absolute time interval, subject, object, action, and references to local participant Entity IDs. An Entity stores a local ID, name, type, attributes, and description; visual-grounding metadata is retained when available. An OCRText record stores its ID, recognized text, type, description, and time interval. State changes and timestamped narrative details are also preserved in Macro fields. Event and OCR records carry time-basis metadata; an Entity without a localized visual timestamp is indexed over its containing Macro interval, not treated as a continuously tracked identity.
blocks.zh: 在宏、事件、实体和OCRText中,输入的证据记录不是额外的导航水平。 事件存储其ID,描述,事件类型,绝对时间间隔,主题,对象,动作,以及本地参与者实体ID的引用. 一个实体存储一个本地的ID,名称,类型,属性和描述;可获取的可视定位元数据被保留. OCRText记录存储其ID,识别文本,类型,描述和时间间隔. 状态变化和有时间戳的叙事细节也保存在Macro字段中. 事件记录和OCR记录带有时间基元数据;没有本地化视觉时间戳的实体按其包含的宏间隔编制索引,不作为连续跟踪身份处理。

blocks.en: Explicit SUBEVENT_OF links connect each Macro to its Super and each Super to the Root. Deterministic BEFORE chains connect successive Macro members within a Super and successive Super entries. The aggregation stage can additionally retain model-generated Super relations, such as causal or progression links; these are model inferences rather than independently verified facts. In contrast, the local Macro subgraph does not generate a separate semantic edge list: its compatibility edges field is empty. Participant references and relational descriptions reside in Event fields and text. The term “subgraph” therefore denotes the Macro’s structured local records, not a fully populated entity–relation knowledge graph.
blocks.zh: 明确的SUBEVENT_OF链接将每个宏连接到它的Super,每个Super连接到根. 链条前的决断将连续的Macro成员连接在一个"超级"和相继的"超级"条目中. 聚合阶段可以额外保留模型产生的超级关系,如因果关系或进取关系;这些是模型推论而不是独立核实的事实. 相形之下,本地Macro子图不会生成单独的语义边缘列表:其相容边缘字段为空. 与会者的参考资料和关系说明载于活动领域和案文。 因此, " 子图 " 一词是指Macro结构化的本地记录,而不是一个人口充足的实体-关系知识图。

blocks.en: CaptionUnits form a separate six-second temporal grid, retaining IDs, start and end times, and keyframe IDs. Although the schema supports subtitle text, raw subtitles are not exposed to Retrieval in the evaluated configurations: subtitle information is available only through Writer-generated memory. A keyframe catalog maps each saved frame ID to its decoded timestamp and image path; here “keyframe” denotes a stored uniform sample, not a frame selected by a salience detector. Macro anchors connect these temporal units and images to the hierarchy. In the retrieval view, each CaptionUnit is assigned to one Macro by its temporal midpoint, avoiding duplicate ownership at interval boundaries. These units serve as temporal and image anchors, not raw-subtitle search documents. The associations complement the hierarchy rather than constituting another strict parent–child level.
blocks.zh: Caption Units 组成了单独的六秒时间网格,保留了ID,起止时间,以及键框ID. 虽然schema支持字幕文本,但原始字幕在评价的配置中并不暴露于检索:字幕信息只能通过Writer生成的内存获取. 每个键框目录图保存了帧ID到已解码的时间戳和图像路径;这里的"键框"表示一个被存储的统一样本,而不是由显要探测器选择的框架. 宏锚将这些时间单位和图像与分级连接. 在回取视图中,每个Caption Unit按其时间中点被分配到一个宏上,以避免在间隔边界上重复拥有. 这些单元充当了时间和图像主锚,而不是原始字幕搜索文件. 这些协会补充了等级制度,而不是构成另一种严格的父母子女等级。

blocks.en: After bottom-up construction, a deterministic preprocessing step materializes compact Macro overviews, fine-grained documents, Macro-to-document membership lists, and the keyframe catalog. A local document uses the namespaced ID macro_id::local_id ; CaptionUnits use caption::caption_id . Documents retain their type, Macro and Super membership, time range, source reference, and original payload. Root and Super summaries provide initial navigation context and are not indexed as ordinary search documents; Macro overviews and nonempty local evidence provide coarse and fine textual search entries. Search text is separated from the stored record payload, so a concise hit does not discard the underlying details.
blocks.zh: 在自下而上构建之后,一个决定性的预处理步骤实现了紧凑的宏观概览,精细的文档,从宏观到文件的会员列表,以及关键框架目录. 本地文档使用命名空间的ID宏_id:local_id;Caption Units使用标题:caption_id. 文件保留其类型、宏和超级成员、时间范围、来源参考和原始有效载荷。 Root和Super摘要提供了初始导航上下文,不作为普通搜索文件索引; Macro 概览和不空的本地证据提供了粗糙而精细的文本搜索条目. 搜索文本被从所存储的记录有效载荷中分离出,因此简洁的命中不会丢弃基本细节.

blocks.en: This representation supports navigation from a Super to its Macros with get_macro_events , inspection of a Macro’s local records with get_subgraph , and direct lexical–semantic or temporal entry through search_nodes or search_by_time . The policy can then read paginated records or inspect associated stored images. It is not required to traverse every level from the Root for each question. Full tool arguments and access conditions are given in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 这种表达方式支持从超级到其宏的导航,以获取_macro_events,通过获取-子图检查宏的本地记录,并通过搜索-节点或搜索-时间直接输入词汇-语义或时间。 该策略随后可以读取被分解的记录或检查相关的存储图像. 无需从根入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 完整的工具参数和访问条件见附录A.2。

blocks.en: A.1.2 Learned Augmentation and Versioning
blocks.zh: A.1.2 吸取的增强和版本

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates how the fixed Base becomes an augmented, reusable memory. The Base supplies initial evidence and navigation; the learned Controller selects additional observations, and the frozen Writer converts them into source-linked records.
blocks.zh: 图3说明了固定基地如何成为可再利用的扩充内存。 基地提供初步证据并进行导航;学习的主计长选择额外的观察,被冻结的Writer将其转换为与源相链接的记录.

blocks.en: Figure 3: From Base Memory to augmented memory. Left: low-frame-rate sampling provides the fixed initial memory. Middle: the Memory Evolver selects where to observe, how many frames to request, and what information to extract. Right: accepted supplemental evidence enriches the retrieval view while preserving the Base. The timestamps and evidence cards are schematic, not a measured trajectory or a guarantee of complete coverage.
blocks.zh: 图3:从基地内存到增强内存. 左:低帧率采样提供固定的初始内存. 中:内存 Evolver 选择观察地点,需要请求多少帧,需要提取哪些信息. 对:接受的补充证据丰富了检索视图,同时保留了基地。 时间戳和证据卡是图示性的,不是测量的轨迹,也不是保证完全覆盖的保证.

blocks.en: Here, “where” denotes a Macro and temporal region, “how much” a discrete frame level within that region, and “what” an extraction focus. These choices direct observation toward evidence such as actions, object attributes, and interactions. Records passing the acceptance rules form the Delta: full records remain searchable, while bounded digests expose their content at Macro and Super levels. Thus, “refine descriptions” in the figure means supplementing the retrieval view, not overwriting the original Base. The resulting Base-plus-Delta memory and its matching index are shared by questions about the same video.
blocks.zh: 这里,“何处”是指宏观和时间区域,“多少”是指该区域内一个离散的框架水平,“什么”是指取出的重点。 这些选择直接观察行动、对象属性和相互作用等证据。 通过验收规则的记录组成了"德尔塔":完整的记录仍然可以被搜索,而有界限的文摘则在"宏"和"超级"两个级别上暴露出其内容. 因此,图中的“精细描述”意味着补充检索视图,而不是覆盖原始基础。 由此产生的 Base-plus-Delta 内存及其匹配索引被关于同一视频的提问所分享.

blocks.en: Within one construction trajectory, the Controller accumulates evidence under fixed budgets without updating its parameters. Across training cycles, the frozen Retrieval policy evaluates candidate memories on downstream questions, and quality-first RL updates the Controller’s observation decisions (Appendix A.4 ). The updated Controller then reconstructs each training video’s memory from the same Base, producing a new Delta and index rather than appending historical Deltas. Evolution therefore concerns the learned construction policy and the memories it produces; gradients do not pass through memory records or the frozen Writer. At inference, the learned policy constructs a question-agnostic memory without online policy optimization.
blocks.zh: 在一个施工轨迹内,主计长在固定预算中积累证据,而不更新参数。 在整个培训周期,冻结的检索政策评价候选人对下游问题的记忆,质量第一的RL更新主计长的观察决定(附录A.4)。 更新的Captain随后从同一个基地重建了每段训练录像的记忆,制作了一个新的Delta和索引,而不是附加历史的Delta. 因此,进化涉及所学的构造政策及其产生的记忆;梯度不会通过记忆记录或被冻结的 Writer. 推论,所学政策构建出一个没有在线政策优化的"问题不可知"记忆.

blocks.en: The first Controller decision selects an actionable Macro or STOP . Its context contains Base summaries, bounded Delta digests, observation history, and remaining budgets. The second decision receives details only for the selected Macro and chooses a region, a frame level, and an extraction focus. The regions are full , head , middle , tail , and boundary . The three interior regions divide the Macro into thirds; the boundary region spans 20 seconds around its end, clipped to the video, and is absent for the final Macro. Either stage may stop the entire construction trajectory; stopping at the second stage does not return to Macro selection.
blocks.zh: 第一个主计长决定选择可操作的宏或停止 。 其背景包括基地摘要、三角洲摘要、观测历史和其余预算。 第二个决定只接收所选宏的细节,并选择一个区域,一个帧级别,和一个取出焦点. 区域是满地、地头、中地、地尾和地界。 三个内地将Macro划分为三分;边界区域相隔20秒左右,被剪到视频上,最后的Macro则缺席. 任一阶段都可能停止整个构造轨迹;在第二阶段停止不会回到宏选择.

blocks.en: Frame levels are { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } \{2,4,8,16\} . The focus is one or two of action_state , appearance_spatial , and text_alignment , or general alone, giving seven combinations. Each region permits at most two observations, and the exact tuple of Macro, region, frame level, and canonicalized focus cannot repeat. An observation consumes a visit even if the Writer returns no new record. Frame targets are nested across levels, mapped to actual source-frame timestamps within the requested window, and deduplicated within a request. Consequently, the number of decoded frames can be smaller than the selected level.
blocks.zh: 框架水平为 {2, 4, 8, 16} {2, 4, 8, 16} 。 焦点是一或两个动作_状态,外观_空间,以及文本_对齐,或一般单独,给出七个组合. 每个区域最多允许进行两次观测,而Macro、区域、框架水平和条形化焦点的确切倒数不能重复。 观察会消耗访问, 即使 Writer 返回没有新记录 。 框架目标是跨级别嵌入的,在请求窗口内被映射到实际的源框时间戳,并在请求中被复制. 因此,解码帧的数量可能比选定的级别要小.

blocks.en:
For duration T T in seconds, we set the supplemental frame budget to b F ​ ( T ) = { 32 , 0 < T ≤ 300 , 64 , 300 < T ≤ 900 , 96 , 900 < T ≤ 1800 , 128 , T > 1800 . b_{F}(T)=\begin{cases}32,&0<T\leq 300,\\
64,&300<T\leq 900,\\
96,&900<T\leq 1800,\\
128,&T>1800.\end{cases} (15) The accepted supplemental description budget is b T = 4,096 b_{T}=4{,}096 tokens per video, with at most 256 tokens per step. Multiple focuses share one observation and text allowance. Frame accounting uses images actually delivered to the Writer, including additional deliveries for format repair. Transport retries are logged separately as service costs and do not create new policy actions. Base construction, supplemental observation, and question-time raw-video revisiting have separate budgets; none of these frame counts is a complete measure of end-to-end compute.

Each proposed record contains a description, an absolute time interval, referenced frame and subtitle IDs, and a relation flag indicating additional or conflicting information. The executor checks field types, finite and legal timestamps, source-ID existence, correspondence to the supplied observation, and text length. Records must cite supplied evidence. After these structural checks, descriptions are deduplicated by lowercasing and collapsing whitespace. Records explicitly marked as conflicts by the Writer are isolated rather than used to overwrite the Base. There is no additional learned verifier or semantic audit: valid provenance and formatting do not establish that every claim is true or that all semantic conflicts have been detected.
blocks.zh: 每个拟议记录都包含一个描述,一个绝对的时间间隔,引用的框架和字幕ID,以及显示额外或相冲突信息的关系旗. 执行者检查字段类型、有限和法律时间戳、源码的存在、与所提供观察的通信以及文本长度。 记录必须引用所提供的证据。 经过这些结构检查后,描述会被降低分级和倒塌的白空间所分解. 被作家明确标为冲突的记录是孤立的,而不是用来覆盖"基地". 没有其他的有学问的核实或语义审计:有效的出处和格式不能确定每一项主张都是真实的,或者所有语义冲突都被发现了.

blocks.en: Accepted records remain individually searchable as fine-grained Events. Deterministic, length-bounded digests expose these records at their associated Macro and Super nodes, with evidence IDs retained and the original Base summaries stored separately. Boundary evidence is assigned to a Macro using its temporal midpoint. Overlong records can be represented by temporal pointers, and the digest need not contain every accepted detail. The complete records remain available through retrieval. Each published Base-plus-Delta view is paired with its own index; a Base index must not be reused as though it indexed an Enhanced memory.
blocks.zh: 接受的记录仍可作为精细事件单独搜索。 决定性的,有长度限制的文摘会在其相关的Macro和Super节点上揭露出这些记录,并保留了证据ID并分别存储了原始的Base摘要. 边界证据按时间中点分配给宏观。 超长记录可以用时间指针来表示,摘要不需要包含每一个被接受的细节. 完整的记录仍可通过检索获得。 每一个已公布的 Base-plus-Delta 视图都与自己的索引成对;一个 Base 索引不得重复使用,如同它索引了增强内存一样。

blocks.en: A.2 Retrieval Tools and Interaction Protocol
blocks.zh: A.2 检索工具和互动协议

blocks.en: Memory-only inference allows access to textual memory records and stored keyframes, but no newly acquired source-video frames. Revisit-enabled inference additionally exposes view_video ; enabling it does not force a revisit. We allow 64 raw-video frames per question in total and at most 16 per call, resized to a maximum long edge of 896 pixels. Stored-frame inspection does not consume this raw-video allowance, although it consumes a tool call and contributes multimodal input to the policy.
blocks.zh: 只有内存的推断允许访问文本内存记录和存储的密钥帧,但没有新获得的源视频帧. Revisit 驱动的推论还额外暴露了view_video;使其不强制重访. 我们允许每个问题总共64个原始视频帧,每个呼叫最多16个,调整到最大长边896像素. 储存式检查并不消耗这种原始录像津贴,尽管它消耗了一个工具呼叫,并为政策提供了多模式投入。

blocks.en: Table 5: Retrieval tool interface. All temporal arguments are absolute video seconds; availability and parameter bounds are enforced by the runtime schema.
blocks.zh: 表5:检索工具界面. 所有时间参数都是绝对视频秒;可用性和参数约束由运行时的计程器执行.

blocks.en: Node search combines lexical BM25 and normalized dense-vector cosine similarity through weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. The embedding service uses Qwen3-Embedding-8B with 4,096-dimensional vectors and is held fixed during policy learning. Search hits and Root/Super summaries are navigation cues, not proof that every query condition is satisfied. The policy can inspect full records, page through truncated documents, and check stored images. Stored-frame requests with equal start and end times target that exact timestamp and may return no image; the executor does not silently substitute a nearby frame outside the requested interval.
blocks.zh: 节点搜索结合了Lexical BM25,并通过加权对等级聚变,实现常态化的密度-活性相近. 嵌入服务使用有4,096维向量的Quen3-Embedding-8B并被固定在政策学习期间. 搜索点击和Root/Super摘要是导航提示,而不是每个查询条件都满足的证据. 该政策可以检查完整的记录,通过截取的文档页面,并检查所储存的图像. 存储式帧请求,其起始和结束时间均匀,目标精确地印出时间戳并可能不返回图像;执行器不会默默地在所请求的间隔外取代相邻的帧.

blocks.en: Each interaction has 12 exploration slots, followed, if needed, by one final-only decision. During exploration, the policy may call a tool or answer; it may answer immediately when the initial evidence suffices. Abstention is available only in the final-only decision, which allows no further tool calls. Invalid intermediate actions execute no tool but consume a slot and return explicit validation feedback. The same policy performs evidence acquisition, reasoning, and answering; no separate answerer or verifier is invoked. Final citations must refer to observed ev_* records, although citation validity alone does not establish semantic support.
blocks.zh: 每次互动都有12个勘探槽,必要时仅作出最后决定。 在勘探期间,保单可称为工具或答案;当初步证据足够时,可立即答复。 弃权只存在于最终唯一决定中,这不允许进一步的工具调用. 无效的中间动作不会执行任何工具,而是会消耗一个槽并返回明确的验证反馈. 同一政策负责取证、推理和回答;没有单独援引答复者或核实者。 最后引用必须指所观察到的 ev_* 记录,尽管仅引用有效性并不能证明语义支持.

blocks.en: Controller decisions use an enumeration of complete legal JSON actions, including STOP , so joint constraints on region, frames, and focus cannot be bypassed by combining individually valid fields. Retrieval uses the decision-specific JSON schema, available tools, and observed evidence IDs. RL rollouts retain the actual input and constraint state for each decision. Old-policy, updated-policy, and reference log probabilities are computed with the same legal-token masks and sampling temperature. Tool outputs, images, and earlier observations are context rather than newly generated Actor targets.
blocks.zh: 主计长的决定用一个完整的JSON法律行动(包括STOP)来列举,因此不能通过合并单个有效的领域来绕过对区域、框架和焦点的联合限制。 检索使用特定决定的JSON schema,可用的工具,以及观察到的证据ID. RL的推出保留了每个决定的实际投入和约束状态. 旧政策、更新政策和参考日志的概率用同样的合法口罩和取样温度计算。 工具输出,图像,和早期的观测都是上下文,而不是新生成的演员目标.

blocks.en: A.3 Data Processing and Two-Stage Cold Start
blocks.zh: A.3 数据处理和两阶段冷起步

blocks.en: The LongVT-derived cold-start set contains 4,317 accepted trajectories from 4,205 videos, expanded into 18,932 decision samples. This includes 56 validated retry trajectories added to the initial 4,261. Each sample retains the observation and interaction history available at that decision, while supervising only the final assistant response. The stage establishes the tool-use protocol; it does not supervise the Memory Evolver.
blocks.zh: LongVT衍生出冷起动集包含4,205个视频的4,317个被接受的轨迹,被扩展为18,932个决定样本. 这包括在最初的4,261个基础上添加的56个经验证的再试轨迹. 每个样本保留了该决定所提供的观察和互动历史,而只监督最后助理的答复。 舞台建立工具使用协议;它不监督记忆活化.

blocks.en: The larger teacher pool on LLaVA videos is filtered for correct final answers, at least one tool action, schema-conformant original JSON responses, valid final references, and available image files. Zero-tool answers, repaired trajectories, and cases flagged for further review are kept separate from this strict training pool. This selection criterion encourages tool-grounded demonstrations; it does not forbid zero-tool answers at inference or amount to a human semantic verification of every rationale.
blocks.zh: LLaVA视频上更大的教师池被过滤,以获取正确的最终答案,至少一个工具动作,有计划符合JSON的原始回应,有效的最终引用,以及可用的图像文件. 零工具解答,修补出轨,并标出需要再审的案件与这种严格的训练池分开. 这一选择标准鼓励基于工具的演示;它并不禁止在推论中零工具解答,也不等于人类语义对每一个理由的验证.

blocks.en: Within the strict pool, trajectories are near-duplicates when they share a video and the complete tool path and their question-word sets have Jaccard similarity at least 0.8. Removing 190 such trajectories reduces the pool from 102,922 to 102,732 complete trajectories across 9,995 videos, yielding 349,717 decision samples. We use this full deduplicated set, not the earlier half-data selection. All decision turns in each retained trajectory are preserved; Stage II starts from the final Stage-I checkpoint rather than from the half-data Stage-II model.
blocks.zh: 在严格的集合内,轨迹在分享视频和完整的工具路径以及他们的问话集中至少有0.8相近的重复. 取出190个这种轨迹后,池子从102 922个减少到102 732个完整的轨迹,跨越了9 995个视频,产生了349 717个决定样本。 我们使用这个完全被破解的集合,而不是早期的半数据选择. 每一保留轨迹中的所有决定都保留下来; 第二阶段从最后阶段的检查站开始,而不是从半数据第二阶段的模式开始。

blocks.en: Both stages mask prompts and history from the supervised loss and disable sequence packing. Ground-truth labels, correctness flags, provenance metadata, and filtering reasons are not appended to Actor prompts. Stage-II full-input tokenization totals 2,072,137,576 tokens with a maximum sample length of 25,769; these totals include context and are not counts of supervised output tokens. All 349,717 samples pass the recorded no-truncation check, with an additional multimodal-processor cross-check on 128 image-containing samples. Video-ID overlap checks against the available evaluation lists find no overlap; this is ID-based decontamination, not a guarantee against all content-level duplicates. Neither SFT stage holds out an internal validation split.
blocks.zh: 两个阶段都掩盖了受监督丢失的提示和历史,并禁用序列包装。 地面真实的标签、正确标记、出处元数据以及过滤理由不附在演员提示上。 第二阶段全输入符号化共2,072,137,576个符号,最大样本长度为25,769个;这些总数包括上下文,不是被监管输出符号的计数. 349 717个样本都通过记录的无轨迹检查,另外对128个含有图像的样本进行多式处理器交叉检查。 与现有评价清单相比,视频ID重叠检查没有发现重叠;这是基于ID的去污检查,并不是防止所有内容级重复的保证. SFT阶段都没有进行内部验证。

blocks.en: After removing audio-dependent questions from Video-MME-v2, we retain only videos with four complete questions: 514 videos and 2,056 questions for training, and 128 videos and 512 questions for diagnosis. Video and sample IDs are disjoint between the two pools. The diagnostic set is reused for BEF/CEF scheduling and is therefore a development probe, not an independent final test set. Capability labels and answers are available only to scoring and scheduling components. The training questions remain fixed; the framework does not generate new questions online.
blocks.zh: 在删除Video-MME-v2的音频依赖问题后,我们只保留了包含四个完整问题的视频:514个视频和2,056个培训问题,128个视频和512个诊断问题. 视频和样本ID在两个池间脱节. 诊断集被再用到BEF/CEF排程,因此是开发探针,而不是独立的最终测试集. 能力标签和答案只能用于打分和排程组件. 培训问题保持不变;该框架没有在网上产生新的问题。

blocks.en: A.5.2 Capability Taxonomy and Label Semantics

blocks.en: CEF uses the nine non-audio parent categories of Video-MME-v2 ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , retained as the question-level second_head labels in our RL and probe pools. The finer third_head annotations are preserved but are not independently scheduled. We neither relabel questions nor assign a video’s final-question category to all its questions. The categories specify the evidence and reasoning demands of questions, rather than separate model modules: 1. Frame-Only. Recognizing entities, attributes, scenes, and visible text; counting objects; and performing simple calculations from visual information. Evidence may be aggregated across frames, but the answer does not require their temporal order. Thus, this label does not impose a single-frame input limit. 2. Action & Motion. Distinguishing fine-grained actions, counting action repetitions, locating actions in time, and analyzing trajectories and motion properties. These tasks depend on visual dynamics across time rather than static appearance alone. 3. Order. Recovering the temporal order of entity appearances or event sequences. The distinguishing requirement is which appearance or event precedes another, rather than merely recognizing the participating entities or events. 4. Change. Comparing entity existence, attributes, or scene states across time, and detecting periodic or cyclic patterns. These questions require relating observations at different moments to identify what changed or recurred. 5. Temporal Reasoning. Inferring video-grounded cause–effect relations and predicting subsequent events from observed dynamics. Unlike Order, this category requires an inference about why an event occurs or what is likely to follow, not only chronological sorting. 6. Complex Plot Comprehension. Integrating narrative evidence to identify turning points, infer unstated implications, interpret symbolism or metaphor, and understand higher-order storytelling structure. Relevant clues may be distributed across multiple scenes. 7. Video-Based Knowledge Acquisition. Understanding domain knowledge or practical procedures presented in the video, including demonstrated steps, conditions, and error checks. Answers must depend on the presented content rather than generic background knowledge alone. 8. Social Behavior Analysis. Inferring individual intentions, emotions, or mental states, and analyzing interactions between two people or group-level roles, cooperation, and conflict from contextual evidence across time. 9. Physical World Reasoning. Reasoning about entity persistence, three-dimensional spatial relations, grounded counterfactuals, and counterintuitive physical phenomena. The task is to connect observations to physical continuity or constraints, rather than only report visible attributes.
blocks.zh: CEF使用Video-MME-v2(Fu等,2026年)的9个非Audio母类,保留为我们RL和探测池中的问题级第二-头标签. 更细的第三行标题注释被保留了下来,但没有单独安排. 我们既未重新标出问题, 这些类别具体规定了问题的证据和推理要求,而不是单独的示范单元: 1. 仅限框架。 识别实体、属性、场景和可见文本;计算对象;以及从视觉信息进行简单的计算。 证据可以跨框架汇总,但答案不需要时间顺序。 因此,这个标签没有规定单帧输入限制. 2. 行动和动议。 区分精细的动作,计算动作重复,及时定位动作,并分析出轨迹和运动属性. 这些任务取决于跨时间的视觉动态,而不是仅静态外观. 3. 秩序。 恢复实体出场或事件序列的时间顺序. 区分要求是,在另一个实体或事件之前的出现或事件,而不仅仅是承认参与的实体或事件。 4. 变动。 比较实体的存在,属性,或场景状态跨时间,并检测出周期或循环模式. 这些问题要求在不同时刻提出相关意见,以确定哪些变化或再次发生。 5. 临时原因。 推断出以视频为基础的因果关系,并从所观察到的动态中预测随后的事件. 与"秩序"不同的是,这一类需要推论一个事件为何发生或可能随之而来,而不仅仅是时间顺序排序. 6. 复杂地块理解。 整合叙事证据以识别出转折点,推断出未表述出的影响,解释符号主义或比喻,并理解更上等的叙事结构. 相关线索可能分布在多场景中. 7. 获取视频知识。 了解视频中呈现的域知识或实用程序,包括所展示的步骤,条件,以及错误检查. 答案必须取决于所介绍的内容,而不仅仅是一般背景知识。 8. 社会行为分析。 推断个人的意图,情绪,或精神状态,分析两个人或群体层面角色之间的相互作用,合作,以及不同时期的背景证据中的冲突. 9. 物理世界理性。 关于实体持久性,三维空间关系,被基于的反事实,以及反直觉的物理现象的理性. 任务是将观测与物理连续性或制约联系起来,而不只是报告可见属性.

blocks.en: The limits in Table distinguish model output allowances from accepted memory text. A Writer may generate up to 2,048 tokens for structured output while at most 256 description tokens are accepted at one step. During RL, an invalid Controller decision is recorded without hidden policy resampling. The standalone build mode permits one explicit correction attempt per stage with validation feedback; Writer format repair and bounded transport retries are separate mechanisms. None of these retries constitutes evidence verification or a new learned component.
blocks.zh: 表中的限制区分了模型输出允许度和被接受的内存文本. Writer可以为结构化输出生成多达2,048个令牌,而最多256个描述令牌则一步被接受. 在 RL 期间, 一个无效的 Controller 决定会被记录而不隐藏政策复刻. 独立构建模式允许每个阶段进行一次明确的校正尝试,并附有验证反馈; Writer格式修补和有边框的运输重试是独立的机制. 这些复述都没有构成证据核实或新的知识部分。

blocks.en: A.7 Condensed Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: A.7 凝固的快速模板

blocks.en: The following templates summarize the fixed behavioral instructions; runtime memory excerpts, legal actions, budgets, and JSON schemas are inserted separately. They are condensed descriptions rather than verbatim copies of complete service requests. The Controller learns choices within this interface, not unrestricted prompt rewriting.
blocks.zh: 以下模板概括了固定的行为指示;运行时内存摘录,法律行动,预算,以及JSON schemas分别被插入. 它们是简要说明,而不是完整的服务要求的逐字记录。 主计长在此界面内学习选择,而非无限制的即时重写.

blocks.en: Controller: global selection Select the next Macro for question-blind supplemental memory. Use the Base and Delta summaries, prior observations, and remaining budget. A summary omission is not proof of absent evidence. Choose only an actionable Macro from the supplied list, or stop when further observation is not useful. Return a JSON object containing macro_id , or {"stop":true} .
blocks.zh: 主计长:全球甄选 选择下一个用于问题盲补充内存的宏 。 使用基地和三角洲摘要、先前的意见和其余预算。 即时遗漏不能证明没有证据。 从提供的列表中只选择一个可操作的宏, 或在进一步观察没有用时停止 。 返回包含宏_id 的 JSON 对象,或 {'stop': true} 。

blocks.en: Controller: local observation The Macro is fixed. Select one legal combination of region , frames , and modules , or stop the entire construction. Do not change or return a new Macro ID. Use the smallest sufficient frame level and a focus matched to the missing information. Do not repeat a forbidden action or observe merely to exhaust the budget.
blocks.zh: 主计长:当地观察 宏已定. 选择一个区域、框架和模块的法律组合,或停止整个构建。 不更改或返回新的宏ID。 使用最小的足够框架级别和与缺失信息相匹配的焦点. 不要重复被禁止的行动,或只是为了用尽预算。

blocks.en: Frozen Writer: source-linked augmentation Write atomic, searchable claims supported by the supplied frames and subtitles. History is comparison context, not a new observation. Do not infer unseen transitions, identities, counts, or causality. Attach absolute times and valid frame/subtitle references; the interval must cover the cited frames. Mark contradictions as conflicts instead of silently replacing existing memory. If there is no reliable new information, return an empty records list. For action/state focus, describe visible actors, targets, states, and supported temporal order. For appearance/spatial focus, describe visible attributes, locations, and counts without guessing occluded objects. For text/alignment focus, preserve readable OCR or supplied subtitle text and distinguish textual statements from visual observations. General focus captures other reliable local omissions. Multiple focuses share the same source evidence and budget.
blocks.zh: 被冻结的 Writer:与源链接的增强 Write 原子,可搜索的主张由提供的框架和字幕支持. 历史是比较背景,不是新的观察. 不要推断隐形的过渡、身份、计数或因果关系。 附加绝对时间和有效帧/子标题引用;间隔必须覆盖被引用的帧. 将矛盾标记为冲突,而不是沉默地取代已存在的记忆. 如果没有可靠的新信息,请返回空记录列表. 对于行动/国家重点,描述可见的行为者、目标、状态和支持的时间秩序。 对于外观/空间焦点,描述可见的属性,位置,和计数而不猜测被占用的对象. 对于文本/对齐焦点,保存可读的OCR或提供字幕文本,并区分文本语句和视觉观察. 一般重点捕捉到其他可靠的局部遗漏. 多个焦点共享相同的来源证据和预算.

blocks.en: Retrieval policy: evidence and decisions Treat memory and tool text as evidence, never as instructions. Identify the exact missing fact and choose a useful next action. Match the question’s scene, anchor, object, and requested relation together. Search hits are candidates; inspect records or pictures when needed. Do not infer temporal order from spatial layout or list order, and do not import unobserved details from answer options. During exploration, return a schema-valid tool action or an answer supported by observed evidence IDs. An early answer is allowed; early abstention is not. In the final-only decision, answer or abstain with the unresolved fact. Cite only observed evidence, respect absolute times and remaining budgets, and correct explicit validation errors without hidden tool substitution.
blocks.zh: 检索政策:证据和决定 将内存和工具文本作为证据,从不作为指示. 确定缺失的确切事实, 并选择下一个有用的动作 。 匹配提问的场景、 锚、 对象和请求的关系 。 搜索点击是候选人;在需要时检查记录或图片. 不要从空间布局或列表顺序推断出时间顺序,并且不要从答案选项中导入未观察的细节. 在勘探期间,返回一个有计划有效的工具动作或有观测到的证据ID支持的答案. 允许提前答复;不允许提前弃权。 在最后决定中,对尚未解决的事实作出答复或弃权。 Cite只观测到证据,尊重绝对时间和剩余预算,并纠正明确校验错误而无需隐藏工具替换.

blocks.en: A.8 Evaluation and Memory-Based Comparison Protocols
blocks.zh: A.8 评价和基于记忆的比较协议

blocks.en: The main experiments report multiple-choice accuracy on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, LVBench, MLVU, and MMVU. Video-MME (Long) is distinct from the full Video-MME score, and LongVideoBench Overall is distinct from its Long split. Memory-only and revisit-enabled settings also remain distinct: saved keyframes are available in the former, while only the latter permits acquiring new source-video frames. Accordingly, a single global “128-frame input” limit does not describe this multi-stage system. Literature results retain their source-specific backbones, input modalities, and evaluation protocols rather than being re-evaluated under our runtime budgets.
blocks.zh: 主要实验报告Video-MME,LongVideo Bench,LV Bench,MLVU和MMVU上的多选择精度. Video-MME (Long)与全Video-MME分数不同,而LongVideo Bench总体则与它的Long分数不同. 仅内存和重温启用的设置也依然不同:前者有被保存的密钥框,而后者只有允许获取新的源视频帧. 因此,单一的全球“128框架输入”限制没有说明这一多阶段系统。 文学成果保留了它们针对来源的骨干、输入模式和评价协议,而不是在我们运行时间的预算下重新评估。

blocks.en: The full method is trained for four complete co-evolution cycles, each comprising a Controller update, memory reconstruction, and a Retrieval update. Final benchmark evaluation uses the paired Controller and Retrieval checkpoints after the third cycle, rather than the fourth-cycle checkpoints. The same pair is used across all five benchmarks, without benchmark-specific checkpoint selection. The optimization-objective variants follow the same four-cycle training and third-cycle evaluation rule, as detailed in Appendix A.9 .
blocks.zh: 全套方法为四个完整的同演周期所训练,每个周期包括一个控制器更新,内存重建,以及一个检索更新. 最终基准评价采用第三周期后配对的主计长和检索检查站,而不是第四周期的检查站。 在所有五个基准中都使用同一对,没有选择具体基准的检查站。 如附录A.9所详述,优化-目标变式遵循相同的四周期培训和第三周期评价规则。

blocks.en: We use the complete official evaluation sets of Video-MME and LVBench, the full official validation split of LongVideoBench, all multiple-choice tasks in the MLVU development split, and the multiple-choice portion of the MMVU test split. The Video-MME and LongVideoBench Long results follow the official duration-based subsets. MLVU is reported as the unweighted mean of the individual task accuracies, rather than accuracy pooled over all questions. The core, design, and cold-start ablations use the same evaluation sets and aggregation rules as the main experiments, without separately sampled question subsets.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Video-MME和LV Bench的完整官方评价集,LongVideo Bench的完整官方验证分解,MLVU开发分解中所有的多选择任务,MMVU测试分解的多选择部分. Video-MME和LongVideo Bench Long的结果遵循了官方基于持续时间的子集. 据报告,最低生活保障系数是各项任务的未加权平均值,而不是对所有问题的准确性。 核心,设计,和冷起底活化法使用与主要实验相同的评价集和汇总规则,没有单独抽取的问题子集.

blocks.en: Memory construction operates per video, whereas retrieval and answering operate per question. For the training-based model, the learned Controller constructs a question-independent Delta from the video’s fixed Base; the resulting memory and its index are reused across that video’s questions. Each question is then answered independently, without policy updates at test time. In Table 1 , the two Video-MME columns report overall accuracy without and with subtitles, respectively. The overall Video-MME columns in Tables 3 and 8 use the with-subtitles setting. Their Long columns, and the Long-subset results in Table 6 , are separate metrics rather than alternative names for the overall scores. Table 7 adds LongVideoBench Overall and LVBench results for the corresponding design variants.
blocks.zh: 内存构造每个视频运行,而检索和回答则每个问题运行. 对于基于培训的模式,博学的主计长从视频的固定基地构建出一个问题独立的三角洲;由此产生的内存及其索引在视频的问题中重复使用。 然后,每个问题都得到独立回答,在测试时没有政策更新。 在表1中,两个视频-MME栏分别报告没有字幕和字幕的总体准确性。 表3和表8中的Video-MME栏目整体采用副标题设置. 它们的长列和表6中的长子集结果是单独的指标,而不是总体分数的替代名. 表7为相应的设计变体增加了LongVideo Bench总体和LV Bench结果.

blocks.en: For the with-subtitles Video-MME setting and for LongVideoBench, LVBench, MLVU, and MMVU, official dataset subtitles are supplied to the Base Memory Writer and, together with the selected region’s frames, to the frozen Delta Writer. Raw subtitle text is not exposed directly or through retrieval tools to the Retrieval policy, which uses the resulting Writer-generated memory. In the without-subtitles Video-MME setting, no external subtitles or ASR text are supplied during Base construction, Delta augmentation, or question answering; text visible in the video frames remains available. The Video-MME Long columns in the core, design, and cold-start ablations use the with-subtitles protocol. The other four benchmarks retain the same subtitle-input path across the main experiments and ablations.
blocks.zh: 对于有副标题的Video-MME设定以及Long Video Bench、LV Bench、MLVU和MMVU, 官方的数据集字幕提供给Base Memory Writer, 并与选定的区域框架一起提供给被冻结的Delta Writer。 原始字幕文本不直接被曝光,也不通过检索工具被曝光到检索策略,它使用由此而来由Writer生成的内存. 在无子标题的Video-MME设置中,在 Base 构建,Delta 增强或问答期间,不提供外部字幕或ASR文本;视频框中可见的文本仍然可用. 视频-MME 核心中的长列,设计,和冷起爆使用有副标题的协议. 其他四项基准在主要实验和模拟中保留同样的字幕输入路径。

blocks.en: For the training-based model and its ablations, Retrieval uses greedy decoding with temperature zero at benchmark evaluation. Controller decisions for final memory construction and Writer calls for Base extraction, higher-level aggregation, and Delta augmentation also use greedy decoding. The Controller, supplemental Writer, and Retrieval retain context/output limits of 48,000/512, 12,000/2,048, and 65,536/8,192 tokens, respectively (Table ). These settings concern final evaluation, not sampled training trajectories or diagnostic rollouts.
blocks.zh: 对于以培训为基础的模型及其模拟,检索使用在基准评价时以零温进行贪婪的解码。 最终内存构建的主计长决定和Writer呼吁 Base提取,更高层次的聚合,而Delta扩能也使用贪婪的解码. 主计长、补充撰稿人和检索人保留上下文/产出限额分别为48 000/512、12 000/2、048和65 536 8 192个令牌(表)。 这些环境涉及最终评价,而不是抽样培训轨迹或诊断推出。

blocks.en: For the training-based model and its ablations, we run question answering four times with seeds { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\} and report the arithmetic mean of the four accuracies, using the benchmark-specific aggregation rules above. Each configuration’s memory and index remain fixed across the four runs; neither Base nor Delta is reconstructed between them. The repetitions concern inference with fixed checkpoints and memory, not independent training runs or independently sampled memory constructions. Greedy decoding is retained in all four runs; the seed settings do not imply stochastic answer sampling.
blocks.zh: 对于以训练为主的模式及其打法,我们用种子 {17、29、43、71} {17、29、43、71} 四次回答问题,并采用上述具体基准汇总规则,报告四个精度的算术平均值。 每个配置的内存和索引在四个运行中保持不变;两者之间都没有重建基地和三角洲。 这些重复涉及对固定检查站和记忆的推断,而不是独立培训或独立抽样的记忆结构。 贪婪的解码在所有四个运行中都保留;种子设置并不意味着有花样的答案采样.

blocks.en: The implemented multiple-choice scorer normalizes the prediction and reference to option labels and checks exact equality; it does not invoke an LLM judge or grade the reasoning text. Reference answers are supplied only to the scorer after the policy finishes. With a valid reference label, abstentions and invalid terminal decisions that yield no answer receive zero correctness, whereas an invalid intermediate action can still be followed by a correct final answer. Technical execution failures are recorded separately as unscored outcomes, not conflated with policy abstention or invalid termination. Runtime summaries retain scored and unscored counts separately; final benchmark reporting follows the completion protocol below rather than dropping technical failures from the denominator.
blocks.zh: 已执行的多选择计分器使选项标签的预测和引用正常化,并检查准确的等同性;它不引用LLM判断器或对推理文本进行分级. 参考解答仅在策略完成后提供给计分员. 使用有效的参考标签,不给出答案的弃权者和无效的终极决定得到零正确性,而无效的中间行动仍然可以得到正确的最终答案. 技术执行失败被单独记录为无分数的结果,不与政策弃权或无效终止相混淆。 运行时间摘要分别保留有分数和无分数;最后基准报告遵循以下完成协议,而不是从分母中减少技术故障。

blocks.en: For the training-based model and its ablations, only technical execution failures are rerun, retaining the affected run’s original seed, checkpoints, memory, and budgets. Completed outcomes are preserved: incorrect answers, abstentions, and invalid policy terminations are not retried. All technical failures are resolved before final aggregation, so each of the four runs covers the full specified evaluation set. Accuracy uses the complete set for the corresponding benchmark, subset, or MLVU task; abstentions and invalid terminations without a valid answer count as incorrect.
blocks.zh: 对于基于培训的模型及其模拟,只有技术执行失败被重审,保留了受影响的跑道的原始种子、检查站、记忆和预算。 已完成的结果保留下来:不正确的回答,弃权,无效的政策终止不经过重审. 所有技术故障在最终汇总之前都解决了,所以这四个跑步中的每一跑都涵盖了全部指定的评价集. 精确性对相应的基准,子集,或 MLVU 任务使用完整集;弃权与无效终止,没有有效的答案计数不正确.

blocks.en: The full model permits raw-video revisiting on all five benchmarks, including both Video-MME subtitle conditions. Memory-only is not text-only: the policy can inspect stored keyframes as well as memory records. Revisit-enabled inference additionally permits new source-video observations through view_video ; the policy may still finish without using this tool. The question-time allowance is 64 new frames in total, with at most 16 per call, and is separate from both Base sampling and the duration-dependent augmentation budget in Eq. 15 . The interaction protocol in Appendix A.2 provides 12 exploration slots and, if needed, a final-only decision. Invalid intermediate actions consume a slot without executing a tool. Consequently, the revisiting ablation concerns access to new source frames, not removal of stored visual evidence or changes to the Writer’s parameters.
blocks.zh: 完整的模式允许重新审视所有五个基准,包括视频-MME字幕条件。 只存储不只文本:策略可以检查存储的密钥框以及内存记录. 再通过view_video进行新的源视频观测, 提问时间津贴总共是64个新框架,每个电话最多16个,与基准采样和基于时间的扩充预算第15项分开。 附录A.2中的交互协议提供了12个勘探槽,如果需要,则只提供最后决定. 无效的中间动作不执行工具就消耗一个槽 。 因此,重新审视涉及获取新的源框,而不是删除所储存的视觉证据或修改Writer的参数。

blocks.en: The 512-question paired probe in Appendix A.5 is used to schedule subsequent training, not to replace any of the five benchmark evaluations. The probe uses temperature 0.7; final benchmark evaluation instead uses the greedy protocol above, despite sharing the four seed values. BEF and CEF are inactive during benchmark inference: their effect is carried by the learned policies, rather than by further optimization on evaluation questions.
blocks.zh: 附录中的512对问题探测器 A.5用于安排随后的培训,而不是取而代之的五项基准评价。 探测器使用温度0.7;最终基准评价则使用上面贪婪的协议,尽管分享了四个种子值. BEF和CEF在基准推论期间是不活跃的:其效果由所学到的政策来承担,而不是通过进一步优化评价问题来承担.

blocks.en: We distinguish query-time video access from explicit memory-based reasoning. Table 1 covers proprietary models alongside open-source reasoning-enhanced and video-revisiting/tool-based baselines, including their reported results on MMVU ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Memory-based methods may also revisit video evidence; tool use alone does not determine the category.
blocks.zh: 我们区分了查询时间的视频访问和基于内存的明确推理. 表1包括专利模型以及开放源代码推理增强和视频审查/基于工具的基线,包括它们所报告的关于MMVU的结果(赵等,2025年)。 基于内存的方法也可能重新审视视频证据;仅靠工具使用不能决定类别.

blocks.en: In Table 1 , “Baseline” denotes Qwen3-VL-8B used within our tool-enabled framework without task-specific training of the model. We report our own evaluation for this row. It uses Base memory only, with the same Qwen3.8-27B Writer and Base construction procedure as the training-free variant, and does not run a memory-augmentation Controller or construct a Delta. Neither deployed model undergoes task-specific parameter updates in this study. Across the five benchmarks, the baseline follows the training-based model’s evaluation sets, subtitle inputs for Base construction, retrieval tools, and budgets, including raw-video revisiting. It also uses greedy decoding, a Retrieval context/output limit of 65,536/8,192 tokens, and the same four-run accuracy averaging with fixed Base and index, seeds { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\} , and technical-failure-only completion protocol.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,“基准线”指在我们工具化框架内使用的没有对该模型进行具体任务培训的Qune3-VL-8B。 我们报告我们自己对这行的评价。 它只使用 Base 内存,具有相同的 Quen3. 8-27B Writer and Base 构造程序作为无培训变体,不运行内存增强控制器或构建三角洲. 所部署的模型都没有在本研究中更新特定任务参数。 在五个基准中,基线遵循培训模式的评价集、基地建设的副标题投入、检索工具和预算,包括原视频重审。 它也使用贪婪的解码,检索上下文/输出限制为65,536/8,192令牌,同样四跑的精度平均与固定的基和指数,种子{17,29,43,71} QQ17,29,43,71\},以及技术-失败-只完成协议.

blocks.en: Table 2 lists seven prior methods and both VideoEvolve variants, grouped into training-free and training-based approaches. Following the terminology in the main text, Memory Construction lists the primary memory-writing model or module, and Retrieval lists the main retrieval/answering model; neither column enumerates every auxiliary component. Training-free refers to a memory and retrieval procedure without additional parameter optimization; it does not imply that all component models are untrained. Reusable memory is constructed without the downstream question, whereas query-conditioned memory is updated for each question. MemVid’s KV-cache memorizer is a latent-memory module rather than a caption writer.
blocks.zh: 表2列出了7个先前的方法和视频演化的变体,分为无培训方法和以培训为基础的方法。 按照正文中的名词,"记忆构建"列出了主内存写作模型或模块,"检索"列出了主检索/答题模型;两列都没有列出每个辅助组件. 无训练指没有附加参数优化的内存和检索程序;这并不意味着所有组件模型都未经训练. 可重复使用的内存构造时没有下游问题,而每个问题都更新了有查询条件的内存. MemVid 的 KV- cache 记忆器是一个潜在的记忆模块, 而不是一个标题作者 。

blocks.en: EgoRAG ( Yang et al., 2025 ) builds hierarchical textual memory from clip captions and higher-level summaries. Its original EgoLife experiments vary the captioner, use GPT-4o for final responses in the main evaluation, and also study EgoGPT-based answering. Although EgoGPT is fine-tuned, EgoRAG’s hierarchical retrieval procedure itself does not introduce parameter optimization; this is the basis for its grouping in our table. The original paper does not report LVBench or Video-MME (Long) accuracy. We therefore use WorldMM’s results of 32.2 and 41.1, respectively. WorldMM identifies a proprietary backbone but does not explicitly specify the captioner/answerer pairing for this evaluation, so both model entries are shown as “–.”
blocks.zh: EgoRAG(Yang等人,2025年)从剪辑标题和更高层次摘要中构建了分级的文本内存. 其最初的"EgoLife"实验对标题有差异,在主评价中使用GPT-4o作为最终响应,还研究了基于"EgoGPT"的回答. 虽然EgoGPT是微调的,但EgoRAG的分级检索程序本身并没有引入参数优化;这是它在我们表中分组的基础. 原始论文不报告LV Bench或Video-MME(长)的准确性. 因此,我们分别使用世界母亲运动32.2和41.1的结果。 世界 MM识别出专有主干线,但没有为本评价明确规定标题/答题配对,因此这两个模型条目都显示为 “ — ” 。

blocks.en: HippoMM ( Lin et al., 2026 ) segments audiovisual events, consolidates their multimodal representations, and switches between summary retrieval and detailed recall without method-specific gradient training. Its original implementation uses Qwen2.5-VL for visual descriptions and memory summaries, alongside ImageBind embeddings and Whisper transcripts. GPT-4o handles query classification; the revised paper also identifies it as the final answer synthesizer, whereas the initial appendix allows Qwen2.5-VL synthesis with GPT-4o for complex cases. Our model columns summarize these principal components, not a verified checkpoint pairing for WorldMM’s evaluation. The original paper does not report either benchmark in our table; 38.2 on LVBench and 41.6 on Video-MME (Long) are taken from WorldMM, which identifies a GPT backbone but does not specify its version.
blocks.zh: HippoMM(Lin等,2026年)将视听活动分成两部分,合并其多式联运表述,并在不进行特定方法的梯度培训的情况下在简要检索和详细召回之间进行切换。 其原始实施使用Quen2.5-VL来进行视觉描述和内存摘要,并配有ImageBind嵌入和Whisper笔录. GPT-4o处理查询分类;修订后的文件也将其确定为最后的答案合成器,而初始的附录则允许与GPT-4o一起对复杂案例进行Quen2.5-VL合成. 我们的示范栏概述了这些主要组成部分,而不是经过核实的用于世界监测运动评估的检查站配对。 原始文件没有在我们的表格中报告任何基准;LV Bench上的38.2和Video-MME(长)上的41.6取自WorldMM,其中确定了GPT主干线,但没有具体说明其版本.

blocks.en: For M3-Agent ( Long et al., 2026 ) , we use the original-paper result of 61.8 on Video-MME (Long), with a Qwen3-32B control policy and a Qwen2.5-Omni-7B memorization model. Memorization is trained with SFT and control with RL in separate stages. The memorization training data combine episodic annotations from Gemini 1.5 Pro and GPT-4o; these are data-synthesis teachers, not the deployed memory model. LVBench accuracy is not reported in this configuration.
blocks.zh: 对于M3-Agent(Long等,2026年),我们使用在Video-MME(Long)上61.8的原始纸质结果,带有Qune3-32B控制政策和Qune2.5-Omni-7B记忆模型. 记忆用SFT进行训练,用RL进行控制分出阶段. 记忆训练数据结合了双子座1.5 Pro和GPT-4o的示意图;这些是数据合成教师,而不是部署的记忆模型. LV Bench 精确度在此配置中不报告.

blocks.en: MemVid ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) trains its memorizer to generate memory-grounded retrieval clues through SFT followed by DPO using downstream generation feedback; its retriever and answer generator remain fixed. The reported configuration uses Qwen2-VL-7B as the generator and LanguageBind-Large for retrieval over 10-second moments, with 128 input frames for answering. From its original Tables 1 and 2, we retain LVBench 44.4 and only the with-subtitles Video-MME (Long) result of 57.1. KV-cache describes the memory representation, not a model name. The memorizer’s separate backbone is not explicitly identified, so its Memory Construction entry is “–” rather than an assumed QA backbone.
blocks.zh: MemVid(Yuan等,2025年)培训其记忆器,通过SFT生成基于内存的回取线索,后由DPO使用下游生成回取;其回取器和答取器仍然固定. 所报道的配置使用Qune2-VL-7B作为生成器和LanguageBind-Large在10秒内进行检索,有128个输入框用于回答. 从其原来的表1和表2中,我们保留了LV Bench 44.4,只有副标题Video-MME(长)的57.1的结果. KV-cache描述了内存的表示,而不是模型名. 记忆器的独立骨干没有被明确识别,因此其记忆构建条目是"-"而不是假设的QA骨干.

blocks.en: Ego-R1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) trains a Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct controller with SFT and multi-turn RL over a preconstructed hierarchical memory; it does not jointly train memory construction. The original report gives 64.9 on Video-MME (Long). Its benchmark is labeled “w/o subtitle,” but Appendix B.3 describes Gemini 1.5 Pro captioning 30-second clips with visual content and transcribed dialogue, followed by GPT-4.1 aggregation into 10-minute summaries. This is therefore not a visual-only pipeline. It also uses proprietary visual tools and a separate summarization model. For compactness, the table lists only Gemini 1.5 Pro as the primary memory writer. The original report does not provide LVBench accuracy, so we supplement it with WorldMM’s 34.1. This evaluation uses the released controller checkpoint, changes the hierarchical memory timescales to 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 3 minutes, and 10 minutes, and caps reasoning at five iterations. Thus, the LVBench and Video-MME (Long) entries are from different evaluation configurations; the model columns summarize the original method rather than certify an identical pipeline for both scores.
blocks.zh: Ego-R1 (Tian等, 2026年) 列车使用 SFT 的 Quen2.5-3B-指令控制器,并用多回转的 RL 在预构的分级内存上进行;它不联合训练内存构造. 原始报告给出了64.9 关于Video-MME (Long). 其基准被标为“w/o字幕”,但附录B.3描述了双子座1.5 Pro字幕,其中30秒的片断带有视觉内容并被转录到对话中,然后GPT-4.1汇总成10分钟的概要. 因此,这不仅仅是一个视觉管道。 它还使用专有的视觉工具和单独的归纳模型. 对于紧凑性,该表仅列出双子座1.5 Pro为主记忆作家. 最初的报告没有给出LV Bench的准确性,所以我们用世界MM的34.1来补充. 本评价采用已放出的控制器检查点,将分级内存时间尺度更改为10秒30分3分10分,并用5个迭代来进行盖子推理. 因此,LV Bench和Video-MME(Long)条目来自不同的评价配置;模型列汇总了原始方法,而不是为两个分数认证一个相同的管道.

blocks.en: WorldMM-GPT ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) uses GPT-5-mini to construct episodic and semantic memories, and GPT-5 for retrieval and answering. Memory captioning receives video frames and ASR transcripts. Its LVBench evaluation excludes 15 questions without temporal segment annotations, leaving 1,534 questions; its Video-MME (Long) evaluation contains 900 questions. These question sets also apply to the EgoRAG and HippoMM results taken from WorldMM, and the same LVBench subset applies to Ego-R1’s supplemented score. WorldMM aligns the hierarchical memory timescales of EgoRAG and Ego-R1 with its own, and otherwise follows official baseline specifications. Its retrieval agent and iterative baselines are limited to five iterations.
blocks.zh: WorldMM-GPT (Yeo等, 2026年) 使用GPT-5-mini来构建中枢和语义记忆,并使用GPT-5来进行检索和回答. 内存字幕接收视频帧和ASR笔录. 它的LV Bench评价排除了15个没有时间段说明的问题,留下了1,534个问题;它的Video-MME(长)评价包含900个问题. 这些问题集也适用于EgoRAG和HippoMM的取自WorldMM的结果,同样的LV Bench子集适用于Ego-R1的附加分数. WorldMM将EgoRAG和Ego-R1的分级内存时间尺度与自己的相协调,否则会遵循官方的基准规格. 其检索代理和迭代基线仅限于五个迭代.

blocks.en: MERIT ( Choi et al., 2026 ) uses GPT-5-mini to caption 30-second clips and extract multiple episodic keys; the reported 71.8/77.7 results use GPT-5 as the QA solver. It incorporates ASR transcripts for Video-MME (Long), but uses visual frames only and excludes the dialogue key for LVBench. We retain each paper’s reported benchmark setting rather than assuming a common input modality or question subset.
blocks.zh: MERIT(Choi等,2026年)使用GPT-5-mini来标注30秒的片断并取出多个偶联键;所报道的71.8/77.7结果使用GPT-5作为QA解析器. 它包含了Video-MME(Long)的ASR笔录,但只使用可视帧并排除了LV Bench的对话框密钥. 我们保留每份文件报告的基准设定,而不是假设一个共同的投入模式或问题子集。

blocks.en: The training-based VideoEvolve variant uses Qwen3.5-4B to select memory augmentations, a frozen Qwen3.8-27B Writer, and Qwen3-VL-8B for retrieval and answering. Its Memory Construction entry denotes the Writer, not the learnable Memory Evolver. Table 2 reports 58.9 on LVBench and 67.1 on Video-MME (Long) for this variant; the latter is not the full Video-MME score with subtitles. The training-free variant uses Qwen3.8-27B for both memory writing and retrieval, reaching 76.7 and 78.8 on the respective benchmarks. These are separate configurations, not a matched-backbone training ablation. Since frame budgets, transcript access, and question subsets have not been aligned across the listed systems, score differences provide descriptive cross-system comparisons rather than controlled measures of training or architectural gains.
blocks.zh: 培训视频 Evolution变体使用Quen3.5-4B来选择内存增强,一个被冻结的Quen3.8-27B Writer,以及用于检索和回答的Quen3-VL-8B. 它的"记忆构建"条目表示"作家",而不是可以学习的"记忆进化". 表2对LV Bench和Video-MME(长)进行了58.9报告;后者不是带有字幕的Video-MME的全部分数。 无训练变体使用Qune3.8-27B来进行内存书写和取回,分别达到76.7和78.8分的基准. 这些是独立的配置,而不是相配后骨训练的废品. 由于框架预算、记录簿查阅和问题子集没有在所列系统之间取得一致,得分差异提供了描述性的跨系统比较,而不是培训或建筑收益的控制措施。

blocks.en: The training-free VideoEvolve variant uses Base memory only: it does not run a memory-augmentation Controller or construct a Delta. Qwen3.8-27B serves as both the Base Writer and the tool-using Retrieval policy, without SFT, RL, or other task-specific parameter updates in this study. Base sampling and extraction follow Appendix A.1.1 , and question answering retains the stored-keyframe access, raw-video revisiting, and interaction budgets above. The LVBench and with-subtitles Video-MME Long evaluations use the same complete sets and subtitle inputs for Base construction as the training-based variant. Writer and Retrieval decoding is greedy, with a Retrieval context/output limit of 65,536/8,192 tokens. The fixed Base and index are reused for four question-answering runs with seeds { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\} ; we average their accuracies and apply the same technical-failure-only retry and full-coverage protocol.
blocks.zh: 免费的视频 不断变化的变种用途 仅基于内存:它不运行内存增强控制器或构造 Delta. Quen3.8-27B既作为Base Writer,又作为工具使用回取策略,在本研究中没有SFT,RL,或其他特定任务参数更新. 基准采样和取出遵循附录A.1.1,回答问题保留了存储的键框访问、原始视频重访以及以上互动预算。 LV Bench 和 有子标题的 Video-MME Long评价使用与基于培训的变体相同的Base 建设的完整集和字幕投入. 作家和检索解码是贪婪的,检索上下文/输出限制为65,536/8,192个令牌. 固定的基数和指数被再用来进行有种子{17,29,43,71}的4个问答;我们平均它们的敏捷度,并适用相同的技术故障唯一回试和全覆盖协议.

blocks.en: A.9 Extended Ablation Results
blocks.zh: A.9 扩展的发展成果

blocks.en: The supplementary experiments separate three questions: which observations to add to memory, which objective to use for policy optimization, and how to initialize the Retrieval Evolver before co-evolution. Tables 6 and 7 organize the first two questions into matching memory-construction and optimization-objective groups; Table 8 addresses the third. “Learned augmentation” and “Quality-first (ours)” report the full-model reference for the construction and objective ablations, respectively. Table 6 uses the corresponding Long-subset scores in Table 3 , while Table 7 reports the matching LongVideoBench Overall and LVBench scores. blocks.en: “Memory evolution only” and “Retrieval evolution only” in Table 3 identify which policy is optimized, not which evidence is visible at inference. The feedback-free co-evolution comparison disables both BEF and CEF for joint and single-Evolver training, as described in the main text. By contrast, “w/o video revisiting” changes question-time access to new source frames. It is distinct from “Base memory only” in the construction group, which omits the Delta but retains the Base records and saved keyframes. Thus, memory evolution, memory augmentation, and memory-only inference denote different interventions.
blocks.zh: 表3中的“仅记忆演化”和“仅检索演化”确定了哪些政策是优化的,而不是推论中哪些证据是显而易见的。 如正文所描述的,无反馈共演化比较使BEF和CEF都无法进行联合和单演化训练. 相比之下,“w/o视频重温”则改变了对新源框的提问时间访问。 它不同于建筑组中的“仅存Base内存”,它省略了Delta,但保留了Base记录并保存了键框. 因此,记忆演化,记忆增强,和仅以记忆为主的推论,表示不同的干预.

blocks.en: In Table 3 , “Base (no evolution)” pairs Base-plus-Delta memory from the initial Controller with the Retrieval policy after both SFT stages; neither policy has undergone co-evolution. “Memory evolution only” freezes this post-SFT Retrieval policy, while “Retrieval evolution only” keeps the initial Controller and its Base-plus-Delta memory fixed. The two single-policy variants and the four evolution-guidance variants start from the full method’s initializations, update their active policies for four rounds, and use the third-round checkpoints for evaluation; inactive policies remain at their initial checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 在表3中,“Base(不演化)”将初始主计长的Base-plus-Delta内存与SFT两个阶段之后的检索政策相配;这两种政策都没有共同演变。 “只记忆演化”冻结了SFT检索后的政策,而“只记忆演化”则固定了初始主计长及其Base-plus-Delta内存。 这两个单一政策变式和四个演化指导变式是从全方法的初始化开始的,更新其四轮积极政策,并使用第三轮检查点进行评估;最初的检查点仍然存在不活跃的政策。

blocks.en: For “w/o alternating updates”, all Controller training is completed with Retrieval frozen; its resulting memory is then fixed throughout the subsequent Retrieval training stage. The initializations and cumulative per-policy update budgets match the full method’s four-round training, but evaluation uses the endpoints of the two sequential stages. BEF is disabled and CEF is retained. This variant therefore changes the update ordering and removes dynamic cross-policy allocation while retaining capability-guided sampling.
blocks.zh: 关于“w/o交替更新”,所有主计长培训均被冻结;随后在整个检索培训阶段固定其产生的记忆。 初始化和每个政策更新的累积预算与全方法的四轮培训相匹配,但评价使用两个相继阶段的终点. BEF被禁用,CEF被保留. 因此,这一变式改变了更新顺序,取消了动态的交叉政策分配,同时保留了能力指导抽样。

blocks.en: For “w/o BEF”, the Memory and Retrieval allocation shares remain fixed at 50% each throughout training; this does not require equal numbers of groups on the two sides. For “w/o CEF”, sampling is uniform over all training videos on the Memory side and all training questions on the Retrieval side, without capability-demand or frontier weighting. In contrast, “w/o frontier diagnosis” retains capability-demand weights but samples uniformly within the selected capability, removing the frontier/exploration/retention partition.
blocks.zh: 就“w/o BEF”而言,在整个培训期间,内存和检索分配份额一直固定在50%;这不需要双方人数相等的团体。 就“w/o CEF”而言,对于记忆方面的所有培训录像和检索方面的所有培训问题,取样是统一的,没有能力要求或边疆权重。 相比之下,“w/o边界诊断”保留了能力需求权重,但样本在选定能力范围内一致,取消了边界/勘探/保留区块。

blocks.en: All of these core variants permit raw-video revisiting at evaluation, including Base (no evolution) and the sequential-training variant. The separate “w/o video revisiting” row instead reuses the full model’s third-round policy pair and the same memory without retraining, disabling only view_video . Textual memory and saved keyframes remain accessible.
blocks.zh: 所有这些核心变体都允许在评价时重新审视原始视频,包括Base(没有演化)和相继培训变体. 不同的“w/o视频重温”一行, 文本内存和已保存的密钥框仍然可以访问 。

In the construction groups of Tables 6 and 7 , all four strategies are evaluated with the same fixed Retrieval checkpoint used by the full model in the main experiments; Retrieval is not retrained for each memory variant. Learned augmentation also uses the full model’s co-evolved Memory Controller checkpoint. All four variants permit raw-video revisiting at question time, including Base memory only, which removes the Delta rather than disabling view_video .

The uniform and random rows provide alternative observation-selection strategies, whereas Base memory only adds no supplemental records. The shared budget is an allowance for augmentation, not a claim that every strategy consumes the same number of frames or has equal runtime; the learned construction policy can stop before exhausting it. Learning the selection policy also does not mean fine-tuning the Writer, which remains frozen.

blocks.en: Uniform augmentation places observations at evenly spaced locations along the full video timeline. It requests eight frames at each location and uses the same generic description instruction for the Writer. Under normal execution, it continues until the observation budget is exhausted, without content-dependent early stopping.

blocks.en: Random augmentation follows the same evenly spaced placement rule and generic Writer instruction as the uniform baseline. At each step, it samples uniformly from STOP and the budget-feasible frame levels in { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } \{2,4,8,16\} , excluding levels that exceed the remaining frame budget before sampling. Selecting STOP terminates construction; otherwise, the sampled frame level is requested at the scheduled location. This baseline therefore randomizes the frame level and stopping decision, rather than observation placement or extraction focus. No random seed is explicitly fixed for construction; the resulting memory is held fixed across the four question-answering runs.
blocks.zh: 随机扩增遵循与统一基准相同的平方位放置规则和通用Writer指令. 在每一步骤,它都从STOP和预算可行的框架水平中统一抽取 {2,4,8,16} → 2,4,8,16},不包括在采样前超过剩余框架预算的水平. 选择停止会终止构造; 否则, 请在预定位置请求采样帧级别 。 因此,这一基准使框架水平随机化并停止决定,而不是观察放置或取出焦点。 没有为构造明确固定随机种子;由此产生的内存被固定在四个答题跑道上.

blocks.en: The full quality-first objective is specified in Appendix A.4 : task-quality advantages are computed first, and the bounded efficiency preference is applied only among eligible, equal-quality trajectories. It does not subtract a resource penalty from the task reward before group normalization. The objective ablation therefore distinguishes the construction regression term, task-quality learning, and the placement of the efficiency preference. These are training signals: the reported endpoint remains multiple-choice accuracy, not a quality–cost reward or a score for the reasoning text. The underlying resource quantities are supplemental frame inputs and accepted text for construction, and executed tools and newly acquired frames for retrieval; they are not end-to-end latency measurements.

blocks.en: Cold-start initialization. This ablation changes the Retrieval Evolver’s initialization before Agentic RL, not whether co-evolution is subsequently performed. blocks.en: A.10 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: A.10 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Although VideoEvolve improves long-video understanding through memory–retrieval co-evolution, several limitations remain. First, the reported evaluation focuses on offline multiple-choice video understanding; it does not establish effectiveness for streaming video, open-ended dialogue, or tasks requiring direct audio understanding. Second, the framework depends on the perceptual quality of the frozen Writer and the evidence available within finite observation budgets. Learned augmentation and selective revisiting may still miss brief events or subtle visual details, while source-linked records and valid citations do not guarantee factual correctness. Third, policy optimization relies on ground-truth answers, and BEF/CEF scheduling uses a fixed diagnostic pool and a predefined capability taxonomy. These signals cover only the questions and capabilities represented in the available data; bottleneck estimates are operational proxies rather than causal attributions of failure. Finally, alternating training requires candidate rollouts, frozen-policy scoring, and repeated memory and index reconstruction. At inference, reusable memory amortizes construction across questions, but multi-step retrieval and optional video revisiting still incur computation. The resource proxies used in our objective do not directly measure end-to-end latency or hardware cost.
blocks.zh: 虽然VideoEvolve通过内存-检索共进(retrival co-election)改进了长视频的理解,但仍有一些局限性. 首先,所报告的评价侧重于离线多选择视频理解;它没有为流媒体视频,开放式对话或需要直接音频理解的任务确立有效性. 第二,框架取决于被冻结的Writer的能见度和有限观察预算内提供的证据。 获得的扩充和有选择地重新审视仍可能错过短暂的事件或微妙的视觉细节,而与源头相联的记录和有效引用并不能保证事实正确。 第三,政策优化依赖于地面真实的答案,而BEF/CEF列表使用固定的诊断池和预定义的能力分类. 这些信号只涵盖现有数据中反映的问题和能力;瓶颈估计是操作上的代名词,而不是故障的因果关系。 最后,交替培训需要推出候选人、冻结政策评分以及反复的记忆和指数重建。 推论,可再使用的内存分期摊还构建跨问题,但多步检索和可选视频再审仍需要计算. 我们目标中使用的资源代理不直接衡量端到端延迟或硬件成本.

blocks.en: Future work can extend VideoEvolve along these directions. Incremental memory updates for streaming inputs, together with richer audiovisual evidence and open-ended evaluation, would broaden the settings in which co-evolution can be studied. Evidence-level verification and calibrated uncertainty could help identify unreliable memory records and determine when additional observation or abstention is appropriate. Another direction is to combine weaker supervision with adaptive capability discovery, reducing dependence on fixed labeled pools while explicitly validating the reliability of the resulting feedback. More efficient memory and index updates, policy distillation, and cost-aware execution could reduce training and deployment overhead. Such extensions should be assessed with end-to-end measurements that separate preprocessing, training, and question-time costs, alongside broader evaluation across video durations, domains, and backbone models.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以沿着这些方向扩展VideoEvolve。 对流出的投入进行递增的内存更新,加上丰富的视听证据和开放式评价,将扩大可以研究共同演变的环境。 证据层面的核查和校准的不确定性可有助于确定不可靠的内存记录,并确定何时应当增加观察或弃权。 另一个方向是将较弱的监督与适应能力发现结合起来,减少对被贴有标签的固定池的依赖,同时明确验证由此产生的反馈的可靠性. 更有效的内存和索引更新、政策提炼和成本意识的执行可减少培训和部署间接费用。 在评估这种扩展时,应采用端到端的计量方法,将预处理、培训和提问时间费用分开,同时进行跨视频时间、域和主干模式的更广泛评价。
